batch: Phase N -- direct gloss-to-M-code-description matching over the remaining adjective pool (630 items), a DIFFERENT method from the abandoned family-expansion approach: checks the word's OWN gloss against each cluster's own definition vocabulary, not a related word's. Yield was low (17/630, ~2.7%) -- most remaining adjectives are physical/generic descriptive words (colour, size, material, number) with no thematic characteristic to match, not a method failure.
